title: Ghouls at the Old Workings
summary: Ghoul sign has been found at the edge of Skarholm: scratches in the spoil and frost where no frost should be. Kit Seam wants 2 of them dealt with.
offer_text: "The ghouls have come closer to Skarholm each night: knocking from where nothing lives. Go to the edge and thin them out, before someone is hurt."
turn_in_text: "Quieter already. I will sleep tonight. A little."

stages.title: Go to the edge of town

objectives.text: Go to where the ghouls were seen
Tell Kit Seam it is done

relationship.label: Kept the ghouls from the edge
